mapping_notice: This is a project-defined control mapping, not an official compliance certification or a claim of conformance to an external framework.

controls.title: Privileged access secret
controls.description: An enable secret is configured where local privileged authentication is used.

evidence.title: Enable secret not found
evidence.evidence: No enable secret command was found in global configuration.
evidence.recommendation: Configure an approved strong enable secret if privileged EXEC access uses local credentials.

controls.title: Legacy enable password
controls.description: Legacy enable password syntax is not present.

evidence.title: Legacy enable password command present
evidence.evidence: An enable password command exists.
evidence.recommendation: Prefer enable secret and safely remove the legacy password after validating access.

controls.title: Password obfuscation setting
controls.description: The configuration includes service password-encryption; this is weak obfuscation, not strong encryption.

evidence.title: Password obfuscation service not enabled
evidence.evidence: service password-encryption was not found.
evidence.recommendation: Review credential exposure. This command is weak obfuscation, not strong encryption.

controls.title: Protected local username
controls.description: A local username using secret syntax is detected.

evidence.title: No local username using secret syntax detected
evidence.evidence: No local username ... secret command was found.
evidence.recommendation: Verify the AAA design; configure protected local credentials if local authentication is required.

controls.title: AAA configuration
controls.description: AAA new-model is explicitly configured where appropriate.

evidence.title: AAA new-model not detected
evidence.evidence: aaa new-model was not found.
evidence.recommendation: Assess centralized AAA (for example TACACS+ or RADIUS) for managed environments; local-only designs may be intentional.

controls.title: Login failure throttling
controls.description: Login failure blocking is configured where supported and appropriate.

evidence.title: Login failure throttling not detected
evidence.evidence: No login block-for command was found.
evidence.recommendation: Where supported, configure login failure blocking based on operational policy.

controls.title: SSH version 2
controls.description: SSH version 2 is explicitly configured.

evidence.title: SSH version 2 not explicitly configured
evidence.evidence: ip ssh version 2 was not found.
evidence.recommendation: If supported, explicitly require SSH version 2 and validate client compatibility.

controls.title: HTTP management service
controls.description: Clear-text HTTP management is not enabled unless explicitly required.

controls.title: VTY management access
controls.description: VTY sections and their authentication, transport and idle-timeout policies are reviewed.

evidence.title: Telnet permitted on VTY lines
evidence.evidence: line vty 0 4: transport input permits Telnet.
evidence.recommendation: Restrict management to SSH where supported; validate remote access before applying changes.

evidence.title: VTY idle timeout not detected
evidence.evidence: No exec-timeout command found in line vty 0 4.
evidence.recommendation: Set an idle timeout appropriate to the security policy.

evidence.title: VTY login method not explicit
evidence.evidence: No login/login local command found in line vty 0 4.
evidence.recommendation: Confirm an intended authentication method is configured for remote access.

controls.title: Log timestamps
controls.description: Log timestamps are explicitly configured.

evidence.title: Log timestamps not explicitly configured
evidence.evidence: No service timestamps log datetime command was found.
evidence.recommendation: Enable useful timestamps for event correlation where supported.

controls.title: Central syslog destination
controls.description: A remote syslog destination is configured and separately verified as reachable.

evidence.title: Remote syslog destination not detected
evidence.evidence: No logging host/IP command was found.
evidence.recommendation: Consider sending logs to a protected central syslog/SIEM service; verify reachability and access controls.

controls.title: Time synchronization
controls.description: An NTP server is configured and separately verified as reachable.

evidence.title: NTP server not detected
evidence.evidence: No ntp server command was found.
evidence.recommendation: Configure approved time sources so logs can be correlated across devices.

controls.title: SNMP community strings
controls.description: Legacy SNMP community strings are reviewed and, where possible, replaced with SNMPv3.

controls.title: Source-routing protection
controls.description: Source routing is explicitly disabled.

evidence.title: Source-routing protection not explicit
evidence.evidence: no ip source-route was not found.
evidence.recommendation: Confirm the platform default and explicitly disable source routing if supported by policy.

controls.title: Directed broadcast protection
controls.description: IP directed broadcasts are not enabled.

controls.title: IPv4 ACL policy
controls.description: ACL definitions and their placement are reviewed against the approved network design.

evidence.title: No IPv4 ACL definitions detected
evidence.evidence: No numbered or named IPv4 ACL definition was found.
evidence.recommendation: If filtering is part of the design, verify ACLs are defined and applied in the correct direction; absence may be intentional.

controls.title: Access-port VLAN assignment
controls.description: Access ports are not explicitly assigned to VLAN 1 where a dedicated VLAN is required.

evidence.title: Access port assigned to VLAN 1
evidence.evidence: GigabitEthernet0/0 is an access port explicitly assigned to VLAN 1.
evidence.recommendation: Move the endpoint to an approved access VLAN if appropriate for the topology.

controls.title: Trunk VLAN restrictions
controls.description: Trunks have an explicit allowed-VLAN list that is limited to required VLANs.

evidence.title: Trunk allowed-VLAN list not explicit
evidence.evidence: GigabitEthernet0/1 is a trunk without an explicit allowed-VLAN line.
evidence.recommendation: Define only required VLANs after verifying both ends of the trunk.

controls.title: Trunk negotiation
controls.description: Trunk negotiation is reviewed and disabled where appropriate and supported.

evidence.title: Trunk negotiation hardening not detected
evidence.evidence: GigabitEthernet0/1 is a trunk without switchport nonegotiate.
evidence.recommendation: Where supported and appropriate, disable DTP negotiation on statically configured trunks.

controls.title: Access-port security
controls.description: Port security is reviewed for access ports where supported and appropriate.

evidence.title: Access port security not detected
evidence.evidence: GigabitEthernet0/0 is an access port without port-security.
evidence.recommendation: Assess platform support and endpoint needs before enabling port security.

controls.title: Edge-port protections
controls.description: PortFast and BPDU Guard are reviewed for genuine endpoint-facing ports.

evidence.title: Access port PortFast not detected
evidence.evidence: GigabitEthernet0/0 is an access port without spanning-tree portfast.
evidence.recommendation: Review edge-port design; configure PortFast only on genuine endpoint-facing ports.

evidence.title: Access port BPDU Guard not detected
evidence.evidence: GigabitEthernet0/0 is an access port without BPDU Guard.
evidence.recommendation: Consider BPDU Guard on edge ports to protect against unexpected spanning-tree BPDUs.

limitations: The current auditor primarily emits findings and does not provide complete pass evidence.
A missing finding is not treated as proof that a control passed.
Static configuration analysis does not verify live reachability, device state, or operational effectiveness.
Controls may be platform-, topology-, or policy-dependent and require human review.
